job.title: Application Consultant SAP Commerce (m/w/d)
job.email_subject: Application: Application Consultant SAP Commerce – Kranti Chavan
job.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Your Application Consultant SAP Commerce role combines application support and business requirements – exactly what I have done for 5+ years on SAP Commerce Cloud at Rockwell Automation and Shell. What I bring in concrete terms:

– Requirements, user stories, functional specs and UAT with business teams
– SAP ERP / PIM / MDM integration with Profisee, DataHub and Hotfolders
– Production support, Backoffice, HAC and CCv2 deployment cycles

This lets me take on real responsibility in your team from day one. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026. My CV and cover letter are attached, and I am happy to walk you through my projects in detail. Could we set up a short 15-minute call in the next few days? I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: Application Consultant SAP Commerce | Techno-Functional | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional SAP Commerce consultant with 5+ years on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Combines application ownership with business analysis: requirements engineering, user stories, functional specifications, process mapping and UAT, plus hands-on configuration, Backoffice, Impex and production support. Delivers PIM / ERP / MDM integration with Profisee, SAP ERP, DataHub and Hotfolders and executes CI/CD deployment cycles on CCv2. Works with international stakeholders in agile teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer and Business User.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

tailoring.why_company: REHAU runs a global B2B business where SAP Commerce must connect cleanly to ERP and product data – the integration-heavy, business-facing setting I know from Rockwell Automation and Shell. I want to take ownership of an SAP Commerce application in an industrial company with international teams and long-term product thinking.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello, the Application Consultant SAP Commerce role at REHAU matches my profile: 5+ years SAP Commerce Cloud (Rockwell Automation, Shell), techno-functional, SAP ERP/PIM integration, SAP certified. Karlsruhe, work permit, start 16.12.2026. Open to a short call?

en.subject: Application: Application Consultant SAP Commerce
en.hook: An Application Consultant for SAP Commerce at REHAU needs to keep a global B2B commerce application running well while translating business needs into working solutions. That is precisely my profile: for more than five years at Rockwell Automation and Shell I have worked on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) between business and IT – certified as SAP Commerce Cloud Developer and Business User.

bullets.label: Application ownership
bullets.text: Supported production issues and troubleshooting, managed the platform through the Hybris Admin Console (HAC), customized Backoffice components and executed CI/CD deployment cycles on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2).

bullets.label: Requirements & solution design
bullets.text: Analysed requirements with business stakeholders, wrote user stories and functional specifications and translated them into SAP Commerce solutions; mapped processes and supported UAT with product owners.

bullets.label: Integration with SAP ERP and PIM
bullets.text: Built and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines with Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub and resolved integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee with international teams.

bullets.label: B2B commerce functionality
bullets.text: Implemented product, catalog, pricing and customer data functionality on Hybris 2211 and maintained Promotions Engine, Order Management (OMS), Cronjobs and Impex.

en.logistics: Working with international business and IT teams is part of my daily routine, which fits REHAU's global setup. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026 after my notice period. I would be glad to discuss in a conversation how I can support your SAP Commerce landscape.
